what: a pictogram that draws itself, then shows what happens to it: icon (a name or a Georgian word), verb rises|falls|stops|opens|closes|moves|splits|joins, said in the scene's narration (N10)
use_when: one thing and what happens to it: gas stops, prices rise, a bridge opens
avoid_when: a person or an event; crime, incidents or deaths (N10)
rules: "sign": one pictogram and what happens to it. icon: an icon name (flame, zap, droplet, bus, train-front, school,
hospital, scale, tag, banknote, route, bridge, snowflake...) or the Georgian word for the thing (გაზი, დენი, წყალი,
მეტრო, ხიდი). verb: rises|falls|stops|opens|closes|moves|splits|joins, and that scene's narration must say it
(გაიზარდა, შემცირდა, შეწყდება, გაიხსნება, დაიხურება, გადავა, გაიყო, შეუერთდა);
